notes.title: Minor update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
- Increased the speed of Joe by two times.

- Added possibility to deactivate achievement and status of the passed level.

To do this in the main menu, select the level you want and press the key combination Ctrl+Shift+D.
This operation does not affect the progress of painted pixels itself.

Unfortunately, in the first 10 minutes after the release for downloading the game was available debug version in which all levels were passed, which when selecting a level immediately activated achievements. If someone managed to download this version, you can use this feature to deactivate levels that were not passed.
